resources.string: All permissions below are required so the lockdown cannot be bypassed or killed by the system.
Monitors active windows during a focus session to block Home, Recent Apps, Notification Shade, and Settings tampering until the timer expires.
Prevents uninstalling or force-bypassing StrictFocus while a lockdown session is active.
Disabling Device Admin will weaken focus lockdown protection.
Device is locked until the countdown reaches zero.
This will unlock your phone for strictly 5 minutes. A non-cancelable background timer will forcefully re-lock your device when 5 minutes expire.
Full access granted. Device will auto-lock when the 5:00 timer ends.
Persistent countdown for active focus lock and 5-minute emergency windows.
